# bioexcel/biobb_analysis/gmx_energy

## Summary

Wrapper of the GROMACS energy module for extracting energy components from a given GROMACS energy file.

GROMACS energy extracts energy components from an energy file. The user is prompted to interactively select the desired energy terms.

Nextflow adapter of the [GMXEnergy](https://biobb-analysis.readthedocs.io/en/latest/gromacs.html#module-gromacs.gmx_energy) building block of [biobb_analysis](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_analysis) 5.3.0.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_ANALYSIS_GMX_ENERGY } from 'bioexcel/biobb_analysis/gmx_energy'

workflow {
    BIOBB_ANALYSIS_GMX_ENERGY(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_energy_path` | yes | edr | Path to the input EDR file |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_xvg_path` | yes | xvg | Path to the XVG output file |
| `versions_biobb_analysis` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_analysis', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of GMXEnergy properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_xvg_path: 'xvg']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_analysis container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_ANALYSIS_GMX_ENERGY' {
        ext.properties = [xvg: 'xmgrace']
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `xvg` | string | "none" | XVG plot formatting. Values: xmgrace, xmgr, none. |
| `terms` | array | "[Potential]" | Energy terms. Values: Angle, Proper-Dih., Improper-Dih., LJ-14, Coulomb-14, LJ-(SR), Coulomb-(SR), Coul.-recip., Position-Rest., Potential, Kinetic-En., Total-Energy, Temperature, Pressure, Constr.-rmsd, Box-X, Box-Y, Box-Z, Volume, Density, pV, Enthalpy, Vir-XX, Vir-XY, Vir-XZ, Vir-YX, Vir-YY, Vir-YZ, Vir-ZX, Vir-ZY, Vir-ZZ, Pres-XX, Pres-XY, Pres-XZ, Pres-YX, Pres-YY, Pres-YZ, Pres-ZX, Pres-ZY, Pres-ZZ, #Surf*SurfTen, Box-Vel-XX, Box-Vel-YY, Box-Vel-ZZ, Mu-X, Mu-Y, Mu-Z, T-Protein, T-non-Protein, Lamb-Protein, Lamb-non-Protein. |
| `binary_path` | string | "gmx" | Path to the GROMACS executable binary. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
